Slim Build.description:
💪 Build: Slim Build
Naturally slender frame with a narrow profile. Minimal bulk, with limbs that look proportionate but not heavy. An understated, lean presence.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Slim Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Slim frame — narrow shoulders and hips, flat profile, long clean lines. Little visible muscle mass, body sits light and vertical in the frame. Female: shoulders narrow and level with narrow hips, slim neck, fine jaw with a soft chin, a light chest line above a narrow waist. Male: shoulders narrow and straight, thin neck, clean jaw, a flat chest on a straight narrow torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at light mass.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
